ASA Version 9.16(4)

hostname FW-EDGE-01
domain-name corp.example.com
enable password $sha512$5000$encrypted_hash
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 nameif outside
 security-level 0
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.252
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 nameif inside
 security-level 100
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 nameif dmz
 security-level 50
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.0
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/3
 shutdown
 no nameif
 no security-level
 no ip address
!
object network WEB-SERVER-01
 host 203.0.113.10
object network WEB-SERVER-02
 host 203.0.113.11
object network DB-SERVER-01
 host 192.0.2.50
object network INTERNAL-SUBNET
 subnet 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0
object network DMZ-SUBNET
 subnet 203.0.113.0 255.255.255.0
object network MGMT-HOST
 host 192.0.2.100
!
object-group network WEB-SERVERS
 network-object host 203.0.113.10
 network-object host 203.0.113.11
object-group network TRUSTED-NETS
 network-object 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0
 group-object WEB-SERVERS
!
object-group service WEB-PORTS tcp
 port-object eq https
 port-object eq http
 port-object eq 8443
object-group service MGMT-PORTS tcp
 port-object eq ssh
 port-object eq 3389
object-group service DNS-PORTS udp
 port-object eq domain
object-group service HIGH-PORTS tcp
 port-object range 8000 8999
!
access-list OUTSIDE_IN remark === Inbound from Internet ===
access-list OUTSIDE_IN extended permit tcp any object-group WEB-SERVERS eq https
access-list OUTSIDE_IN extended permit tcp any object-group WEB-SERVERS eq http
access-list OUTSIDE_IN extended permit tcp any host 203.0.113.10 eq 8443
access-list OUTSIDE_IN extended deny ip any 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0
access-list OUTSIDE_IN extended deny ip any any log
access-list INSIDE_OUT remark === Outbound from LAN ===
access-list INSIDE_OUT extended permit tcp 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0 any eq https
access-list INSIDE_OUT extended permit tcp 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0 any eq http
access-list INSIDE_OUT extended permit udp 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0 any eq domain
access-list INSIDE_OUT extended permit tcp 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0 any eq smtp
access-list INSIDE_OUT extended permit icmp 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0 any
access-list INSIDE_OUT extended deny ip any any log
access-list DMZ_IN remark === DMZ to Internal ===
access-list DMZ_IN extended permit tcp host 203.0.113.10 host 192.0.2.50 eq 5432
access-list DMZ_IN extended permit tcp host 203.0.113.11 host 192.0.2.50 eq 5432
access-list DMZ_IN extended deny ip 203.0.113.0 255.255.255.0 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0 log
access-list MGMT_ACL remark === Management Access ===
access-list MGMT_ACL extended permit tcp host 192.0.2.100 any eq ssh
access-list MGMT_ACL extended permit tcp host 192.0.2.100 host 203.0.113.10 eq 3389
access-list MGMT_ACL extended deny ip any any
!
nat (inside,outside) dynamic interface
nat (dmz,outside) static 198.51.100.10
nat (inside,dmz) static 192.0.2.50 203.0.113.50
!
route outside 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 198.51.100.2 1
route inside 10.0.0.0 255.0.0.0 192.0.2.2 1
!
: end
